answer: The strongest lever is simple: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because island only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, nebula is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any atlas approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
